body: VARN GOSAM, the elven prince turned sun-priest, leader of the Malakim in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: an elf living among desert men; male; ageless, looks about forty; tall, lean and wiry. Sun-bronzed skin, a narrow face with high cheekbones, long straight black hair, long pointed elf ears, bright amber-gold eyes.
costume: flowing white-and-cream priest's robes with gold embroidery, an ochre sash and a loose cream headscarf.
signature: A GOLDEN SUN-DISC with straight pointed rays, the holy sign of Lugus, always hangs on a heavy chain at his chest.
extra: He never squints: even in the brightest light his amber-gold eyes stay wide open and his brows relaxed.

vibes.name: Never Squints
vibes.line: His right hand gripping a staff planted beside him, his left pushing back the edge of his headscarf so no shade falls on his face; eyes wide open, unblinking, straight into a rising sun beyond the frame, lips parted; a white temple terrace at sunrise, men below shielding their eyes.
vibes.wears: the sun-priest's vestments: flowing white-and-cream robes with gold embroidery, an ochre sash, a loose cream headscarf.

vibes.name: Mist Born
vibes.line: His right hand lowering the dark hood of his elven cloak as one shaft of sunlight breaks through the mist onto him, his left holding a cold, unlit silver lantern; a faint smile, brows drawn up, eyes straight at the viewer; the dark, mist-filled Shadowed Vale behind him, late afternoon.
vibes.wears: the clothes of an elven prince of the Shadowed Vale: a close-fitting coat of charcoal-black silk with silver leaf clasps, a long dark grey cloak beaded with mist.

vibes.name: Elf Among Men
vibes.line: His right hand tipping a goatskin into the clay bowl of a sunburned pilgrim, his left steadying its neck; head bent to listen, a broad smile, eyes on the pilgrim; a caravanserai courtyard at blue dusk, oil lamps under white domes, the men around him a head shorter.
vibes.wears: a Malakim caravaner's dusty indigo robe and a long indigo head-veil wound loosely so his long ears show, a plain leather belt.

vibes.name: Sun-Struck
vibes.line: Holding a gold-framed burning-glass up to the blazing noon sun in his right hand, its bright point kindling the altar fire, his left feeding dry palm fronds into the flame; laughing open-mouthed, face washed gold, eyes wide on the viewer; a white rooftop sun-altar at noon.
vibes.wears: light high-summer festival vestments: a sleeveless saffron-yellow linen robe, broad gold armbands, a pleated sunburst collar of gold-dyed linen spread across his shoulders.
